← Back to campus

A campus built from observation.

132 photo galleries, street-level views, architecture sources and elevation references used to guide the recreation. Photographs remain at their original sources; they are visual references, not copied game textures. Modelled façades and many dimensions remain approximations.

Visually inspected: eight upper glazing rows, pale projecting aggregate bands, individual blinds / opaque panels, dark services and base, entrance at the western side and separate roof enclosure. Component dimensions are reconstructed; the 40 m / ten-level map tags remain.

Figure 4, printed p. 5 / PDF p. 7: west parapet RL 87.01, east plant room RL 90.55 and exhaust flues RL 95.00. Different components are modelled separately. The height card derives flue height from the coarse DEM, assuming compatible datums; these are planning levels, not an as-built survey.
